name: Alejo Sureda Oteo
role: Backend developer in training · 2nd year DAM
bio1: I'm in my second year of Multiplatform Application Development (DAM) at Salesianos Zaragoza. I got hooked on programming during my previous vocational course, building class projects, and what I enjoy most is the part nobody sees: the data model, triggers, permissions and APIs.
cm_desc: Each user has a profile, follows other collectors and organises their Pokémon and football cards into public or private collections, with grading (PSA, BGS, CGC…), rarity, language, purchase price and photos. All of this so they can manage their real collection digitally.
cm_role: The whole backend and database: data model, triggers, RLS policies and the Supabase connection. Small UI changes; a teammate did the design.
crm_desc: Sales opportunities with their pipeline, companies, individuals and their pets, plus the HR side: clock-ins, holidays, hiring processes, reviews and payslips employees sign by drawing.
crm_role: Backend and database: schema, triggers, functions, RLS permissions and the contact API. Some UI and user experience tweaks.
contact_p: If you have a project, an internship or want to talk backend, drop me a line.
